messages.subject: color vs colour
parts:
Hi everyone, I think I maybe have found a bug, or is the expected
behaviour? I get an error when using color to code for colors of a
factor and with colour I don't. Here's the code

qplot(ind, values, colour=grp, data=alkfos2)

everything is fine with this, but with:

qplot(ind, values, color=grp, data=alkfos2)

Error en eval(expr, envir, enclos) : objeto 'grp' no encontrado
which in english means "obejct 'grp' not found"

but works with:

qplot(ind, values, color=alkfos2$grp, data=alkfos2)

I'm sorry if this is intended, I'm new to ggplot.

Bye

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: color vs colour
parts:
Yes, this is a bug which will be fixed in the next version.
